title: Lovely Irish Aubergine Fold
description: A hearty and flavorful aubergine dish, ideal for a date night in, with a dairy-free twist.
instructions: Cut the aubergine in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds.
In a small bowl, mix together the lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly over both aubergine halves.
Place the aubergine on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 30 minutes.
While the aubergine is roasting, heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the chickpea flour and water to create a batter.
Pour the batter over the onion and cook until the mixture thickens, stirring constantly.
Remove the aubergine from the oven and let it cool slightly.
To assemble the fold, place one aubergine half on a plate, spoon some of the onion mixture over it, and top with the other aubergine half.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
